verdict.rationale: PayPal documents in-assistant checkout for two of the named surfaces. ChatGPT is covered through the ACP path, using Instant Checkout via `requestCheckout()`, an MCP `complete_checkout` tool and Braintree delegated tokens. Gemini/Google AI Mode is covered through the UCP path with a Google Pay handler, while Store Sync lets agents create carts and complete purchases conversationally, flowing orders into the merchant's existing OMS. The core story is delivered, but each path is gated: Braintree is required for Agent Ready, access is form-gated, Google enablement is needed for UCP, and Store Sync is limited to US physical goods in USD. Missing for 10: documented checkout on Claude, Copilot and other peer assistants; self-serve access without Braintree/form/Google gating; support beyond US physical goods; independent or hands-on corroboration of live in-chat purchases.
